recalls.summary: Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2016-2018 Mazda3 vehicles.  A defective windshield wiper relay may cause the windshield wipers to become inoperative, reducing the driver's visibility.

recalls.component: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
recalls.summary: Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2014-2018 Mazda3 and 2016-2021 CX-3 vehicles.  The rearview camera image may not display properly by showing a flickering or distorted image.
